text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky achieved brilliant results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: As for her, having weathered the fiercely competitive world of racing alongside her Trainer—
(*swish*...... *plop*)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Her long-cherished wish fulfilled, she spent her days lazily enjoying her retired life.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And they lived happily ever after.
The end♪
choice_data_list: Don't go into retirement on your own, please?!
Don't just retire on your own?!

text_block_list.text:
Only her first three years have ended.
While it certainly marks a milestone, her racing journey is far from over...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Shh, quiet.
You'll scare the fish away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer, since you came all the way out here,
just give in and quietly drop a line in the water.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I've worked hard for three whole years, so wild horses couldn't drag me out of here today~

...It seems Seiun Sky is truly serious.
She says "just for today," but if this keeps up,
she'll end up slacking off indefinitely.
choice_data_list: (In that case, I have a plan of my own!)

text_block_list.text:
What does it take to get Seiun Sky in the mood?
After three years together, I already knew the answer.
choice_data_list: I'm gonna check my phone for a sec.
I'm gonna check my phone for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Help yourself~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...*yawn*
Sure is nice weather out...—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
That was a little too deliberate.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's so obvious you're just trying to get my attention.
Sei-chan isn't gonna take the bait—
choice_data_list: "Absolute Champion! The Overlord of the Century's End is Born!" it says!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? The 'Absolute Champion', you say?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no,
I have nothing to do with that stuff anymore."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I don't wanna do anything tiring,
and I'm bored of coming up with strategies~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm even thinking maybe
I should make a living fishing—
choice_data_list: It says, "Is this Umamusume taking over this year!?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —The realm itself.

Seiun Sky closed her eyes and listened to the murmuring of the river for a while.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...You really are quite reckless, aren't you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Asking an Umamusume who's already past her prime
to pull off something so huge... man, oh man.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When people talk about ruling the realm and all...
it kinda makes you wanna flip it all upside down, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...All right,
time to get moving, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fuha, seriously,
you couldn't be more unnatural if you tried.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see? Looks like
my positioning was a bit off right here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like anything's biting here at all,
so I'm thinking of changing spots~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There's a woooonderful place that's waaay greener and looks so nice to run on~
choice_data_list: Looks like we could catch a big one over there!
Looks like you could catch a big one over there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer-san.
Let's aim for the next big catch—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Shall we start our strategy meeting?♪
